Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3964. Join molecule_dictionary to activities to assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an inner join. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
